about: Dấu labels “Đề xuất” for underlining (D13) only on an app where in-place replacement measured wrong: Ghostty. Every app types without underline until the user turns it on. Apps where a terminal is one field among many (VS Code, Cursor, Claude) are not labeled for their terminal (D43). Terminal is not suggested. Bundle IDs from docs/Compatibility.md section 3.

apps.name: Visual Studio Code
apps.note: Electron. Measured 10/11/2026 (VS Code 1.145.2, M1 machine): in-place right in 14 of 15 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal; the other run lost its first few keys and ran right after an Apple Telex field chosen through the API (cause not checked; remeasured in M7 step 3).

apps.name: Google Chrome
apps.note: Chromium. Measured 10/11/2026 (M3 Max machine): in-place right in 7 of 7 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal and 3 of 3 with a busy page; 3 of 3 with a busy page again on 17/11/2026 (Chrome 157, M1 machine, edited string at 100 ± 30 ms); TipTap editor 9 of 9 (12/11/2026); label removed.

apps.name: Microsoft Edge
apps.note: Chromium (Microsoft Edge Framework). Measured 10/11/2026 (M1 machine): in-place right in 9 of 9 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal and 3 of 3 with a busy page; label removed.

apps.name: Cursor
apps.note: Electron. One app with two kinds of window: Agents (a prompt box) and IDE (the editor and an agent panel, ⌘L). Measured 17/11/2026 (3.30.14, docs/Compatibility.md 5.4): in-place right in all three places, standard string at 5 ms (editor 3 of 3) and 20 ms, edited string at 100 ± 30 ms, "anh ddi" from a new document at 20 ms 2 of 2. The editor answers positions from the start of the document. Underline not measured on 3.30.14.

apps.name: Ghostty
apps.note: Terminal drawn by the app (AppKit, Metal). Ignores replacementRange and reports the cursor at {0,0}; Dấu has no special handling for it (D43). Measured 11–12/11/2026 (1.4.0, docs/Compatibility.md 5.6): in-place wrong at 120 ms; underline right, but Return right after an underlined word is swallowed (Ghostty's own bug, Apple's Telex too).

apps.name: Figma
apps.note: Electron, content drawn on a canvas. Not measured.

apps.name: Firefox
apps.note: Gecko. Measured 10/11/2026: in-place right in 7 of 7 runs at 5, 10 and 20 ms nominal (M3 Max machine) and 3 of 3 with a busy page (M1 machine); label removed.
